column1: # module-caps.tsv: a module that must not be planned above a version while another module is installed (GM-14).
# Read by bin/atlascap.py (steps/triage.md item 4, after crosscalls.py). Columns: id, when_installed (module name in the
# app), capped module, max version (inclusive), status, why, source. status "grounded" = the cap was proved on a run;
# "check" = taken from the run's observation, the exact boundary is not verified (confirm with `mxcli marketplace versions`
# and a build before relying on it). A cap holds a plan line back; it never downgrades an installed version.

column6: Atlas_Core 3.20+ (3.22.0 and 4.6.0 seen) uses `@extend .col-<bp>-3`, which needs the PDS grid; mx check and idcheck pass, only the mxbuild theme compile fails. 3.19.0 is the version that built before the step.
